verdict.rationale: Vanta documents an integrations catalog for cloud infrastructure, version control, productivity tools and identity providers. Named examples include AWS (40+ resources), Azure, Okta, GitHub and Wiz, so the cloud, identity and code-hosting parts of the story are covered. MDM appears only as a category the Vanta API can automate, not as a native connector, and HR and ticketing integrations are never named. Nothing in the evidence describes read-only permission scopes. Missing for 10: evidenced HR and ticketing integrations, native MDM connectors, documentation of read-only scopes/permissions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
